task.title: Subscribing to webhooks
task.shortdesc: Get notified when something changes in your shelter, instead of polling the API.

prereq.p: You need a key with the webhooks:manage scope and an HTTPS endpoint that can receive POST requests.

step.cmd: Create a subscription for the events you need.

stepresult.p: The response includes a signing_secret. Store it securely.

step.cmd: In your endpoint, verify each delivery's signature.

info.p: Compute an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body with your signing secret, and compare it with the CorgiBase-Signature header. Reject requests that don't match.

step.cmd: Respond with any 2xx status within 10 seconds.

info.p: Failed deliveries are retried with backoff for up to 24 hours. Use the event's id to ignore duplicates.
